name: codebase
description: Skills and agents for understanding unfamiliar codebases and writing code that fits them: whole-repo onboarding (codebase-onboarding), exhaustive single-mechanism traces (subsystem-deep-dive), transferable-pattern extraction for a new project (engineering-pattern-extraction), staleness audits of existing architecture docs against git history (docs-drift-audit), and finding existing in-repo precedent to model new code after (pattern-finder).
